title: Application of novel silica stabilized on a covalent triazine framework as a highly efficient heterogeneous and recyclable catalyst in the effective green synthesis of porphyrins
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1081-1094
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07875F, Paper

In this study, we present the design, synthesis, and utilization of a covalent triazine framework (CTF) as an innovative catalyst for porphyrins synthesis.
